About us
At Keysight, we empower innovators to bring world-changing technologies to life. Since our beginnings in a Silicon Valley garage, we’ve understood that innovation is a journey. You need a collaborative advisor who’ll provide expertise and tailored solutions to take you from concept to reality.

Push the boundaries of engineering and deliver the best product experiences with our technologies, measurement expertise, and tailored solutions, built from a foundation of co-innovation with industry ecosystem leaders. Gather insights, sooner, to build and go-to-market with confidence.

Keysight (NYSE: KEYS) serves technology innovators as a mission-critical design enablement partner for the world’s most complex engineering challenges. By connecting market-leading design, emulation, and test solutions across the full lifecycle, Keysight helps engineering teams accelerate innovation, reduce risk, and bring new technologies to market faster. Customers across AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor, and general electronics rely on Keysight to bridge virtual design and physical reality, enabling confident decisions earlier. Learn more at www.keysight.com.

Ready to design the future? Start here, with Keysight.

Congratulations to
Jason A. Kary
, Keysight’s incoming Chief Financial Officer.
 
Jason will step into the CFO role in mid-December as part of a planned succession. He has played an important part in Keysight’s growth and value creation, leading teams across finance and operations. He most recently served as President of our Electronic Industrial Solutions Group, and before that as Treasurer and Head of Investor Relations. Along the way, he has built strong relationships with our customers, helped shape our financial strategy, and developed a deep understanding of what makes Keysight successful.
 
Our outgoing CFO,
Neil Dougherty
, has led our finance organization as CFO for an impressive 13 years. From building a strong financial foundation to helping guide the company through periods of growth and change, Neil has been a steady hand and made a lasting impact on Keysight. We’re grateful for his leadership and guidance, and are pleased he’ll remain with us in an advisory role for fiscal year 2027 to support the transition.
 
Please join us in congratulating Jason and thanking Neil for his tremendous contributions to Keysight!
